source: IBPS CRP CSA (Clerk) notification and syllabus (ibps.in) and past paper pattern
intro: Prelims is a qualifying screen. The mains paper decides the merit, and there is no interview. A local language test follows the mains for the state you applied to.
note: IBPS lists the test names and broad areas in its notification. Topics below are the areas that repeat in past papers.

sections.name: English Language
topics: Error spotting, fill in the blanks, sentence improvement

sections.name: Numerical Ability and Quantitative Aptitude
topics: Simplification and approximation, number series, quadratic equations
Arithmetic: percentage, ratio, average, profit and loss, interest, time and work, speed and distance

sections.name: Reasoning Ability
topics: Blood relations, direction sense, coding and decoding, order and ranking

sections.name: General and Financial Awareness
topics: Current affairs, banking and financial awareness
RBI, payment systems, financial inclusion, government schemes
Static GK: important days, awards, organisations

sections.name: Local Language Proficiency Test
topics: Reading, writing and understanding the local language of the state you applied to. Candidates who studied the language in Class 10 or 12 are exempt with proof.
